headlines.title: 印尼开始推介首批熊猫债 试图实现融资渠道多元化
headlines.summary: 印尼周二已公布首批熊猫债发行的条款。作为东南亚最大的经济体，该国正试图在汇率波动和财政挑战的背景下实现融资渠道多元化。根据债券发行文件，该国拟发行三年期和五年期熊猫债，初步发行规模合计最高可达70亿元人民币。该文件显示，印尼已获准于未来两年在中国银行间债券市场发行总额至多达300亿元人民币的熊猫债。“投资者对我们发行的中国债券一直反应积极，”印尼财政部长普尔巴亚·尤迪·萨德瓦周二在简报会上表示。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Indonesia begins promoting first panda bonds in bid to diversify financing channels
headlines.summary_en: Indonesia announced the terms of its first panda bond issuance on Tuesday. As Southeast Asia's largest economy, the country is seeking to diversify funding sources amid exchange rate volatility and fiscal challenges. According to the bond issuance documents, Indonesia plans to issue three-year and five-year panda bonds with an initial combined size of up to 7 billion yuan. The documents show Indonesia has been approved to issue up to 30 billion yuan in panda bonds on China's interbank bond market over the next two years. 'Investors have been very positive about our Chinese bond issuance,' Indonesian Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said at a briefing on Tuesday. (Bloomberg)

headlines.title: 印尼确认拟发行熊猫债筹资70亿元人民币
headlines.summary: 印尼财政部长Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa周二在雅加达举行的国家预算简报会上表示，印尼计划通过首次发行熊猫债筹集70亿元人民币，约合10亿美元。债券定价预计于7月23日进行，具体仍取决于市场情况。Purbaya表示：“投资者对我们的人民币债券反应积极”。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Indonesia confirms plan to raise 7 billion yuan via panda bond issuance
headlines.summary_en: Indonesian Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said at a state budget briefing in Jakarta on Tuesday that Indonesia plans to raise 7 billion yuan, about $1 billion, through its first panda bond issuance. Bond pricing is expected on July 23, depending on market conditions. Purbaya said: 'Investors have been positive about our yuan-denominated bonds.' (Bloomberg)

headlines.title: 瑞银证券孟磊：短期震荡后，继续看好科技和AI为下半年市场主线
headlines.summary: 瑞银证券中国股票策略分析师孟磊表示，近期全球资本市场出现剧烈波动，在科技板块的交易拥挤有所释放后，科技板块和AI仍是下半年的市场主线。科技板块受益于全球人工智能的快速发展以及国内政策的大力支持有望维持强劲的盈利增长。包括行业主题ETF、科技赛道型主动公募、融资、私募等各类资金有望持续净流入科技板块。

headlines.title_en: UBS Securities Meng Lei: After short-term volatility, tech and AI remain favourites as underpinning themes for H2 market
headlines.summary_en: UBS Securities China equity strategy analyst Meng Lei said recent sharp volatility in global capital markets, after a relief in technology sector crowding, technology and AI remain the market's main themes for the second half of the year. The technology sector, benefiting from rapid global AI development and strong domestic policy support, is expected to maintain robust earnings growth. Various funds, including sector-themed ETFs, technology-focused active public funds, margin financing, and private funds, are expected to continue net inflows into the technology sector.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: STAR 50 Index soars 10.73%, semiconductor and chip stocks rally across the board
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market rebounded after a morning decline, with the STAR 50 Index surging over 10%. Semiconductor chip stocks collectively rallied, with Huawei Hongli, GigaDevice, NAURA Technology, JCET and over 20 others hitting涨停, while SMIC, Cambricon and many others rose over 10%. PCB, CPO and other AI hardware stocks gained, with Jindu Electronics, Shengyi Technology, Han's Laser, Lintel Technology and others hitting涨停, and Zhongji Innolight, Optowide Technologies rising over 10%. On the downside, oil stocks bucked the trend and fell, with Keli Shares dropping nearly 10%. Rising stocks outnumbered decliners, with over 3,000 stocks in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen markets in the green. Total turnover was 2.97 trillion yuan. By the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.79%, the Shenzhen Component rose 4.81%, and the ChiNext Index rose 7.05%. 2. In terms of sectors, semiconductors, memory chips, CPO, glass substrates and other sectors led the gains, while oil, healthcare, baijiu, pork and other sectors lagged.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stock movers: Real-Time Technology closes up 10.48%; multi-scenario synergy drives growth, civil aviation visual intelligence market share significantly ahead
headlines.summary_en: Raywell Technology (7656.HK) surged in afternoon trading, closing up 10.48% at 27.4 Hong Kong dollars, with a market cap of 8.365 billion Hong Kong dollars. Raywell Technology is the first company listed under the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's Chapter 18C special technology rules with a 'visual embodied intelligence' positioning, combining 'AI + vertical scenarios + embodied extension.' There was previously no comparable listed company. According to Frost & Sullivan, based on 2025 revenue, the company ranked first in China's civil aviation enterprise visual intelligence product market with an 8.7% share, and fourth in China's commercial space enterprise visual intelligence product market with a 1.7% share. headlines.title: Ikea’s China remodelling: parent firm puts 8 former retail sites on block
headlines.summary:
Ikea’s parent company Ingka Group has hired property consultancy JLL as its sole sales agent to offload eight retail properties in mainland China, the multinational furniture brand’s largest asset disposal since it entered the market nearly 30 years ago.

headlines.title: 上海上半年外贸同比增长18.6% 出口首次突破万亿元大关
headlines.summary: 上半年上海外贸整体运行稳步向好，进出口2.55万亿元，同比增长18.6%。其中出口1.14万亿元，增长20.1%，首次突破万亿元大关；进口1.41万亿元，增长17.4%，外贸规模创历史新高。（央视新闻）

headlines.summary_en: Shanghai's foreign trade performed steadily in the first half of the year, with imports and exports totaling 2.55 trillion yuan, up 18.6% year-on-year. Exports reached 1.14 trillion yuan, up 20.1%, surpassing 1 trillion yuan for the first time; imports were 1.41 trillion yuan, up 17.4%, with the trade scale hitting a record high. (CCTV News)
